notes: DRAMeXchange 'Last Update' per box: DRAM spot 2026-10-19 11:00 GMT+8 (daily); GDDR spot 2026-10-05 14:40 GMT+8 (weekly); Module spot 2026-10-05 14:40 GMT+8 (weekly); NAND wafer spot 2026-10-12 14:40 GMT+8 (weekly).
NAND wafer spot prices are quoted by DRAMeXchange per die-equivalent unit of the stated density (e.g. one 512Gb TLC die), not per whole wafer.

Spot series = session average in USD on the price date the page states (not the fetch date); High/Low are the day's (daily boxes) or the week's (weekly boxes) range; Change % is the change DRAMeXchange shows next to each item.
Spot prices recorded since 2026-10-17: DRAMeXchange's older history is members-only, so each series grows by one point per page update.
TrendForce releases are kept when the title mentions DRAM, NAND, HBM, SSD, flash, memory or contract prices; % figures are copied from the title and summary.
